idea-plugin.name: Auto Theme Switcher
idea-plugin.description:
Automatically switch IntelliJ IDEA themes based on time


Features:
  • Schedule automatic theme switching at specific times (precise to the minute)
  • Support two time-based theme configurations
  • Instantly switch to any installed theme manually
  • Smart priority: later time setting takes precedence
  • Persistent settings across IDE restarts

Usage:
  1. Open Tools → Auto Theme Switch
  2. Enable scheduled switching and configure your themes and times
  3. Or use instant switch to change theme immediately
